topic: Mohenjo-daro in today's Pakistan, around 2500 BCE: a planned city of the Indus Valley with straight streets, covered drains and the Great Bath.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: The Streets of Mohenjo-daro

shots.narration: One sparkle-jump, and we're in Mohenjo-daro!
shots.scene: Sunlit ancient brick street in Mohenjo-daro, 3D animated adventure film look, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize inside a swirl of dust and golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Dazzling golden light, bright blue watch glow, welcoming adventure.

shots.narration: Today's Pakistan, around 2500 BCE: a city of the Indus Valley.
shots.scene: Wide view along sunlit brick buildings and intersecting streets in Mohenjo-daro, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the city.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, sandy colors, delighted discovery.

shots.narration: [excited] This planned city had straight streets!
shots.scene: Long straight street bordered by baked-brick walls, clear vanishing point, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya points down the straight street.
shots.mood: Bright, orderly brick geometry and curious wonder.

shots.narration: But Tock can't see past these walls!
shots.scene: Street corner between tall sunlit brick walls, low viewpoint at Tock's height, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Tock stretches upward on his tiny legs.
shots.mood: Gentle comic frustration, towering warm brickwork.

shots.narration: Zoya chooses a straight street to explore.
shots.scene: Straight brick-lined lane beyond the corner, dusty ground in bright sunlight, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya leads Tock down the lane.
shots.mood: Confident yellow hoodie, cheerful brass companion, inviting path.

shots.narration: [surprised] Look beside the street: covered drains!
shots.scene: Street edge with a brick-lined drain beneath flat covering slabs, a small opening revealing the channel, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya crouches beside the drain opening.
shots.mood: Clear sunlit details, blue watch glow, fascinated discovery.

shots.scene: Close view through an opening beneath drain covers, brick channel with a shallow trickle of water, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Water flows along the brick channel.
shots.mood: Warm brick textures, soft reflected light, clear visual explanation.

shots.narration: Tock follows the lane, eager for another discovery.
shots.scene: Sunlit lane with covered drains beside brick walls, wider opening ahead, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.mood: Playful spring tail, golden dust, growing anticipation.

shots.scene: Elevated view revealing the Great Bath's large rectangular brick-lined basin and descending steps, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya points toward the Great Bath.
shots.mood: Grand sunlit reveal, rich brick colors, delighted awe.

shots.narration: Steps lead down into its brick-lined basin.
shots.scene: Safe level walkway overlooking the Great Bath, rectangular basin and brick steps clearly visible, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Tock tilts his glass face toward the steps.
shots.mood: Calm curiosity, warm sunlight, impressive ancient architecture.

shots.narration: Straight streets, covered drains, and the Great Bath—discoveries complete!
shots.scene: Broad brick walkway beside the Great Bath, sunlit walls behind, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya gives Tock a triumphant thumbs-up.
shots.mood: Friendly celebration, bright yellow hoodie, gleaming brass.

shots.scene: Great Bath courtyard with Zoya's wristwatch glowing blue and golden sparkles gathering nearby, vertical 9:16, no writing.
shots.action: Tock turns his round glass face toward Zoya.
shots.mood: Eager questioning expression, magical golden glints, another adventure waiting.

episode.endHook: Zoya's watch sparkles again—what amazing place will they explore next?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Mohenjo-daro in today's Pakistan, around 2500 BCE. Explore an Indus Valley planned city with straight streets, covered drains and the Great Bath!
